attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Initiated for Critical Workload
attributes.description: Detects restore or recovery activity for a workload explicitly identified as critical in Druva recovery event details or resource metadata.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects restore or recovery activity for a workload explicitly identified as critical in Druva recovery event details or resource metadata.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
  or druva.event_type:*Recover*
  or druva.event_type:*Restore*
)
and (
  druva.resource.type:*critical*
  or message:*critical*
)
